name: The Tech Block – Tech News and Articles

ios.desc:
The Tech Block is the only app you need if you're looking for the best tech reads.

We scour the web for two reasons: First, we want to provide you with the best tech-related content so you no longer have to wonder if you've missed that great article or news story. And second, we want to help content creators get the recognition they deserve. All of the Featured articles, News and Videos are hand-picked to insure that you’re only getting the best. Using human curation and a non-bias approach, we strive to promote the best tech content without the noise.

If you have a suggestion for an article or news story, let us know! It does not need to come from a big publication. We LOVE indie writers.

Email us: publish@thetechblock.com
